_meta.notes: Five-line illegal-content-only policy drafted by T00 (RULE_6). T40 owns enforcement.

value: We remove content that depicts or facilitates child sexual abuse material.
We remove content that contains a credible threat of violence against a person.
We remove content that publishes another person's private personal information.
We remove content that facilitates illegal activity.
Nothing else is removed for content reasons; offensive, political, weird and hostile expression stays.
